subject: Expansion: additional apps & team keys for Q1 rollout
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@gearshift.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion request: additional apps & keys for Q1 rollout

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — our product teams were impressed by the latency and cost controls. We're planning to roll Redwood into two more product lines in Q1 and want to get ahead on provisioning and terms. High level: 3 new apps across two squads, pilot in staging in Jan, production by end of Feb.

Asks:
- Can you provision 12 additional API keys scoped per app (dev/stage/prod)?
- We'd like a short-term increase in burst capacity for the pilot (approx +25% of current committed throughput)
- Any change in term or pricing if we consolidate these into a single renewal? We currently have an annual commitment that renews March 2027.

I've CC'd our procurement alias (procure@gearshift.ai) so they can coordinate contract work if needed. Would you have time next week for a 30m call to align on MAP and timelines?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform
GearShift

Attachments: none
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion request: additional apps & keys for Q1 rollout

Alex —

Really appreciate the context. Congrats on the positive internal feedback. We can support this expansion and I sketched a pragmatic rollout that minimizes risk and keeps costs predictable. Summary below, full MAP attached (gearshift-MAP-v2.xlsx).

Proposed approach (staged):
1) Staging pilots (Jan 4–Jan 31): 3 apps, 12 keys (each app: dev/stage/prod), temporary burst +25% capacity for pilot windows.
2) Production ramp (Feb 1–Mar 1): gradual steady-state traffic routing; autoscaling config to cap sustained cost.
3) Commitment / terms: we can fold these apps into your March renewal. If you increase committed throughput by >=30% across account we can offer a 10% uplift discount on per-token rates for those committed units for the 12-month renewal.

Operational asks from you:
- Confirm list of app names and primary owners so we tag keys correctly.
- Confirm expected peak qps per app for staging windows (helps sizing).
- Procurement: send the billing/contact details and any PO requirements.

Attachments I will include for the call:
- gearshift-MAP-v2.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestones)
- draft SOW (we'll prepare SOW version to sign once terms are agreed)

Next steps: 30m sync — I'm available Tue 11/24 10:00–11:00 or Wed 11/25 14:00–15:00 PT. If procurement prefers DocuSign, Ben will drop the link.

Mina Haddad
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187

Mina / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. We're aligned on the staged plan and the 10% committed-unit discount sounds reasonable. A few confirmations from our side:
- Please provision 12 keys (3 apps × 4 environments: dev/stage/prod/shared-internal) — we will map owners this afternoon.
- Target: keys provisioned and available by Dec 10, 2026 so teams can run integration tests before Jan pilot.
- We accept the proposed pilot burst (25%) as temporary; if burst exceeds that we will notify you.
- Performance ask: during staging we expect 95th percentile single-token latency under 90ms for our typical prompts. Can Monica include a brief performance-runbook and a chase path if SLOs deviate during the pilot?

Procurement (procure@gearshift.ai) — please confirm billing entity and any PO format requirements. We'll sign the SOW once DocuSign link is live. I've attached the signed internal approval PDF for reference.
